summary_bullets: Redact malformed ADOPTED sentinel errors with the same fixed token used for ISSUE_NUMBER and RUN_ID.

commit_message:
Harden ADOPTED sentinel error redaction

Use the fixed malformed-value token for invalid ADOPTED sentinel values and update the paired harness and contract docs. Also document why get-issue-context.sh keeps stricter issue-number validation than older all-digit peers.
